story: A loud growl came from the dark cave.
All of Mira's friends stepped back.
Mira took a breath and went in to look.

details.text: She walked into the dark cave.
She wore her favorite red boots.
She had a snack on the way.

story: A new kid sat all alone at lunch.
No one went over to talk to him.
Sam moved his tray and shared his food.

details.text: Sam likes ham sandwiches the best.
Sam shared his lunch with the kid.
Sam sat by the big window.

story: Lena found a strange, shiny rock.
She turned it over and over.
She asked the teacher how it was made.

details.text: She put the rock in her coat pocket.
The rock was small and grey.
She asked how the rock was made.

story: Theo carried a tall stack of cups.
The kitchen floor was slippery and wet.
Theo took tiny, slow steps and spilled none.

details.text: He took tiny, slow steps.
He likes the orange cups.
There were ten cups in all.

story: The little seed took weeks to sprout.
Ada watered it every single morning.
She waited and waited, and at last it grew.

details.text: The flower pot was a bright blue.
She waited weeks for it to grow.
She used a small watering can.

story: Bo broke a vase by accident.
No one had seen it happen.
Bo told his mom the truth right away.

details.text: The vase sat on a high shelf.
Bo was playing in the hall.
He told his mom the truth.

story: Nina had three shiny stickers.
Her best friend had none at all.
Nina handed two of hers right over.

details.text: She gave two stickers to her friend.
The stickers were shaped like gold stars.
Nina kept one sticker for herself.

story: The whole yard was full of leaves.
Max's friends ran off to play.
Max raked all afternoon until it was clean.

details.text: He wore his bright green garden gloves.
He raked leaves all afternoon long.
The leaves were red and brown.

page_title.en: Marlo's Magnifier — Show Me the Proof (Grade 1)

page_intro.en: Marlo the raccoon is a story detective, and every case is a clue hunt: read a short story, then a clue card says something about a character — "Mira is brave." Tap the detail from the story that PROVES it, not just any true thing that happened. A warm Grade 1 reading game about describing characters with key details and finding the evidence, aligned to Common Core RL.1.3.
